purpose: Self-contained proven anti-stall pattern catalog for Zero-Loss Chat Accelerator.
promotion_policy: Promote only from explicit user correction, objective reproduction, repeated independent incident, or authoritative specification plus observed behavior. Never weaken scope, safety, verification, or required persistence.

rules.failure: Skill transition drops the current execution state
rules.required_behavior: Preserve the full continuity capsule and resume the exact next action; skills overlay rather than restart.

rules.failure: A guardrail/subskill becomes the workflow owner
rules.required_behavior: Perform the bounded gate/subroutine and immediately return ownership to the parent domain workflow.

rules.failure: Skill activation triggers broad skill/connector/repository/history enumeration
rules.required_behavior: Read exact known targets first; enumerate broadly only when identity or a named acceptance gap is unresolved.

rules.failure: Always-loaded instructions carry cold detail and increase context/latency
rules.required_behavior: Keep SKILL.md compact and push cold provider/QA/benchmark/troubleshooting detail into conditional references.

rules.failure: Equivalent reads/searches/discovery repeat without invalidation
rules.required_behavior: Single-flight and reuse versioned evidence until a real invalidator exists.

rules.failure: Read-only investigation continues after root cause and edit set are actionable
rules.required_behavior: Apply implementation crossing/read-only circuit breaker, mutate, targeted-test, or checkpoint.

rules.failure: Multiple equivalent queries add no new material fact
rules.required_behavior: After two no-new-fact searches, change source/strategy or act on existing evidence.

rules.failure: Same job/run/state is observed repeatedly without transition
rules.required_behavior: After two unchanged observations, stop busy-waiting; use exact identity, milestones, and independent work.

rules.failure: Broad workflow/run discovery repeats after exact run identity is known
rules.required_behavior: Query the exact run/job ID; rediscover only when evidence proves a replacement run.

rules.failure: A failed operation is retried on the same route/payload with no invalidator
rules.required_behavior: Retry only after route/payload/pressure/auth/provider state changes or a real retry window.

rules.failure: Provider is retried before Retry-After/backoff expires
rules.required_behavior: Honor provider backoff and advance unrelated work during the wait.

rules.failure: Network/subprocess calls or retry budgets can hold an interactive run for minutes
rules.required_behavior: Use finite timeouts, small retry ceilings, resumable state, and exact recovery identity.

rules.failure: Broad validation reruns on unchanged state
rules.required_behavior: Use targeted checks during iteration and broad suites at convergence or after material state change.

rules.failure: Status/handoff/report work displaces creation of a current runnable artifact
rules.required_behavior: Protect build-first: produce/retain the usable artifact before concise closeout ceremony.

rules.failure: Static/server/client/render/package gates rerun after each micro-edit
rules.required_behavior: Run the smallest disconfirming gate during iteration, then the full release gate at convergence.

rules.failure: Unchanged visual states are rendered repeatedly
rules.required_behavior: Reuse deterministic render evidence/config and render only changed/risky/final required states.

rules.failure: Returning from a file-format/helper skill triggers a full canonical-source rescan
rules.required_behavior: Reuse source IDs/hashes and process only changed sources, then resume parent exact next action.

rules.failure: Repair/history knowledge is reread in full after each iteration
rules.required_behavior: Do one targeted lookup keyed to the current signature/version and reuse it until invalidated.

rules.failure: Market/pipeline/current-state sources refresh repeatedly without a freshness need
rules.required_behavior: Reuse a fresh sourced snapshot; refresh the exact target only before the action that needs freshness.

rules.failure: Send/apply/delete/publish/write actions are duplicated or fragmented speculatively
rules.required_behavior: Never speculative-duplicate mutations; coalesce coherent writes and record authoritative write responses.

rules.failure: Unchanged bytes/state are re-uploaded, relisted, or reverified repeatedly
rules.required_behavior: Batch changed artifacts at coherent checkpoints, reuse remote IDs, and verify once per changed state.

rules.failure: Useful progress remains only in ephemeral state during a long CI/native/package gate
rules.required_behavior: Checkpoint coherent proven state before the long gate and preserve exact recovery identity.

rules.failure: Heavyweight jobs are overlapped on the same constrained runner/cache
rules.required_behavior: Avoid competing heavy gates; overlap them with non-heavy independent work instead.

rules.failure: A slow low-priority sibling blocks a fast gateway in a barriered wave
rules.required_behavior: Split waves so the gateway can unlock the downstream critical path first.

rules.failure: Partial/truncated results cause the whole expensive operation to restart
rules.required_behavior: Treat truncation as partial success and continue from returned cursor/range/resource boundary.

rules.failure: User is asked again for information already available
rules.required_behavior: Reuse conversation/connector/tool/standing-rule state; ask only for genuinely blocking user-only choices.

rules.failure: Work is performed on a stale/wrong repository/file/build and must be repeated
rules.required_behavior: Resolve canonical identity once, preserve it, and prove the runtime loaded the new artifact.

rules.failure: Missing tooling either stops the task prematurely or is reinstalled/reprobed repeatedly
rules.required_behavior: Recover required tooling once on the critical path, prove it, and reuse the recovered environment state.

rules.failure: Multiple waves only restate plans/status without changing evidence or state
rules.required_behavior: Treat narration as non-progress; after two dead waves force a strategy change and real state transition.

rules.failure: Status/handoff/catalog artifacts are rewritten after every micro-edit
rules.required_behavior: Checkpoint meaningful coherent state and write concise deltas after useful progress.

rules.failure: A resumed task repeats the same broad ecosystem survey instead of advancing unresolved coverage
rules.required_behavior: Maintain a coverage ledger and search only frontier gaps/stronger sources/deep candidates.

rules.failure: Compaction/resume/handoff loses the exact next action and triggers rediscovery
rules.required_behavior: Persist a compact watermark/capsule before interruption and resume from it with delta-only retrieval.

rules.failure: One slow connector/process/job holds the entire workflow hostage
rules.required_behavior: Give the wait a finite interactive lease, preserve exact identity, checkpoint coherent progress, and advance every independent acceptance item after lease expiry.

rules.failure: Elapsed wall-clock time grows while evidence, mutation, checkpoint, acceptance, and blocker state remain unchanged
rules.required_behavior: Judge health by progress signatures and meaningful milestones; after two no-progress waves change strategy instead of merely waiting longer.

rules.failure: Canonical target, root cause, and safe edit are known but the workflow continues reading or explaining
rules.required_behavior: Apply the known-action mandate: within the next wave mutate, targeted-test, checkpoint, or identify the exact blocker preventing mutation.

rules.failure: Compaction, long wait, risky handoff, or interruption occurs without a compact resumable execution state
rules.required_behavior: Persist acceptance/completion, canonical IDs/hashes, run IDs, checkpoint/mutation/test, blocker, no-repeat history, and exact next action before the risky boundary.

rules.failure: An interactive wait lease expires but orchestration keeps polling the unchanged operation
rules.required_behavior: Release the hostage wait, preserve identity, advance independent work, and resume observation only after a real invalidator or meaningful milestone window.

rules.failure: A real stall is recovered but its causal signature and successful recovery are not captured
rules.required_behavior: Record a compact stall fingerprint and promote only proven recurring/generalizable causes into the embedded Stall Brain and machine audits.

rules.failure: Anti-stall behavior relies only on hidden/global/user memory that may not load or may be unavailable
rules.required_behavior: Keep Zero Loss itself as the enforceable source of truth; use persistent memory/custom instructions only as redundant reinforcement, never as the sole control plane.

rules.failure: Watchdog bookkeeping creates extra calls/files/status churn on ordinary short tasks
rules.required_behavior: Apply watchdog behavior silently; run the watchdog script only for long, interruption-prone, or already-stalled work where deterministic state tracking materially helps.
